content:
The judge notes that the marital home is jointly owned property pursuant to Article 177 of the Italian Civil Code and that the personal nature of the property has not been proven. The division is therefore made in equal parts pursuant to Article 194 of the Italian Civil Code. The value of the property was estimated by a technical consultant and revalued according to ISTAT indices. With regard to compensation, D.T.U. is recognised as having the right to civil fruits (rental fees) for the loss of enjoyment of his share, since S.V.'s exclusive use is not justified and no alternating or shared use has been granted. The failure to live together peacefully and the judicial separation reinforce this conclusion. The costs of the proceedings are apportioned on the basis of S.V.'s partial defeat.The judgment clarifies the criteria for the division of jointly owned property after separation, emphasising the application of exclusive use and the right to compensation for the loss of enjoyment of the co-ownership share. It provides an important reference for quantifying the value of jointly owned property and determining civil fruits in cases of unauthorised exclusive use, particularly in disputes between former spouses.
